name: Perplexity AI
mood: Scholar's parchment behind clean glass, with warm paper canvas, compact search UI, left sidebar, soft cards, and one restrained Deep Teal accent.

parchment.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, and nav backgrounds.

warmMist.role: Hairline card, input, and button borders.

ash.role: Muted helper text and secondary labels.

graphite.role: Nav icons, secondary buttons, and inactive labels.

ink.role: Primary text, icon fills, and dark button backgrounds.

pureBlack.role: Rare maximum-contrast text and icon accents.

deepTeal.role: Active nav item background, selected chip fill, badge fill, and search-input glow.

rules: Use normal letter spacing across sizes.
Use 16px for main text, 14px for UI labels, and 11-12px for micro labels.

cardSurface.role: Suggestion cards and elevated content blocks.

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.recipe: Transparent Graphite icon and label, 12px padding, active Deep Teal fill with white text and 12px radius.

components.name: Ghost Button
components.recipe: Transparent, Graphite text, Warm Mist border, 6px radius, 8px by 12px padding.

components.name: Pill Chip
components.recipe: Full pill, Ink text, 8px by 12px padding, active Deep Teal fill with white text.

components.name: Filled Action Button
components.recipe: Ink fill, Parchment text, 12px radius, 8px by 12px padding.

components.name: Suggestion Card
components.recipe: Soft Paper, 16px radius, 12px vertical padding, subtle shadow, Ink title and Graphite description.

components.name: Search Input
components.recipe: Parchment background, 12px radius, 16px padding, Warm Mist border, Graphite placeholder, about 640px wide.

components.name: Badge Tag
components.recipe: Deep Teal fill, white 11px text, full pill radius, 2px by 8px padding.

do: Use Parchment as the base canvas.
Reserve Deep Teal for active states, badges, selected chips, and search glow.
Cap the main content column at 900px.
Use flat surfaces and compact spacing.
dont: Do not introduce new accent colors.
Do not use Pure White as a broad surface.
Do not use teal for body text.
Do not add gradients, blurs, photography, or screenshots.

imagery.style: Pure UI, typography, spacing, and monochrome glyphs.
rules: Use simple glyph icons in Ink or Graphite.

layout.structure: Two-pane application layout with fixed left sidebar and centered main column.
layout.sidebar: About 260px wide with nav items, brand mark, labels, and sign-in.
layout.main: Centered 900px max-width column with category nav, wordmark, 640px search input, and two-column suggestion grid.
layout.rhythm: Compact 8px element gaps and 32px section gaps.

preview.note: Refero exposes preview imagery, but local download was not captured in this environment.
